set.body: Seen on 2026-09-26 in ioJVM/doc, ioJS/doc, codecJS/doc and codecJVM/doc during tools/study-consumer/verify.py (publishLocal), always passing on a clean rerun with no source change. Traces pointed at scaladoc's SignatureBuilder.content() being null, and once at a lambda inside Diagnose givens (UI-G G2 fixed that instance by naming the subject functions, 43b9d3f). It happens more under heavy machine load (load ~20, several sbt builds at once). Risk: verify.py or a hosted publish fails at random. Next: reproduce with a single-module doc task in a loop under load, capture the full stack, check whether Scala 3.7.4 scaladoc has a known NPE on anonymous functions in givens or on inline/erased signatures, and either work around it (name the lambdas) or pin or upgrade scaladoc.
set.title: Intermittent scaladoc NullPointerException in publishLocal/doc (verify.py)
